doNotTouchYet.reason: Core map internals. Touch only after route-level lazy boundary is audited or patched.

recommendedPatchOrder.label: Review likely lazy targets
recommendedPatchOrder.action: Start with likelyLazyTargets priority 1 files that are not core map internals.
recommendedPatchOrder.reason: Route-level lazy loading is lower risk than changing SHSOperationalMapboxMap.jsx internals.

recommendedPatchOrder.label: Patch one route boundary only
recommendedPatchOrder.action: Use React.lazy/Suspense or dynamic import for one Exchange/Unified Truth route surface.
recommendedPatchOrder.reason: One route boundary keeps visual testing manageable.

recommendedPatchOrder.label: Build and compare chunks
recommendedPatchOrder.action: Run production build and compare pages/vendor-map/vendor chunks.
recommendedPatchOrder.reason: The goal is measured chunk movement, not theoretical optimization.

recommendedPatchOrder.label: Browser recheck affected route
recommendedPatchOrder.action: Open the affected Exchange/Unified Truth route and confirm no blank screen.
recommendedPatchOrder.reason: Lazy loading route surfaces can fail if exports or fallbacks are wrong.

recommendedPatchOrder.label: Only then consider core map dynamic patch
recommendedPatchOrder.action: If route-level lazy loading does not move the bundle, patch SHSOperationalMapboxMap.jsx with extra caution.
recommendedPatchOrder.reason: Core map internals are higher risk and should not be first unless necessary.
